I answered Hollis in a reply to his message in #central-random: the ticket is #88412.

Tobias posted it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025. It was the Tier 2 escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 freezing on the BOL barcode scan. He also confirmed the account was Tansleigh Packaging (TSP), not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he can see that thread himself.

I also told him that the Central weekly for Jul 13, 2026 uses PD-88412 for an unrelated Marrow Fieldworks issue. I suggested he put the account code next to the number in the tracker so the two don't get mixed up.
